Hi, my name is Ian. I am a teaching assistant with a passion for electronics, tech, and video games.
Over the past few years, I have turned some of my projects into products and sell them around the web.
This site shows a selection of some things I have made.

cols.html: A devise to extract Gameboy camera images to PNG files. This project started with a very basic way to get picture off a Gameboy camera and on to my phone, but has become much more.
